notes: EBIT in the DCF input is proxied by GAAP operating income (“Operating income”) from Vistra’s consolidated statements of operations. ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

Capex uses the cash flow line “Capital expenditures, including nuclear fuel purchases and LTSA prepayments” (absolute dollars). This may not map 1:1 to strictly maintenance capex. ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

Net working capital (NWC) is constructed as total current assets minus total current liabilities. For FY2023, this relies on StockAnalysis.com (primary FY2023 current balances were not extracted from the SEC HTML due to access errors). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/vst/financials/balance-sheet/))

WACC (0.085) and terminal assumptions (terminal growth 0.02; exit multiple 9.0) are modeling choices; Vistra does not provide a single directly usable WACC/terminal parameter in the retrieved snippets. ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

Tax rate (0.17) is based on Vistra’s disclosed effective tax rates around FY2024-FY2025 (modeled as a base-case average). ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

NOL balance is mapped from the 10-K deferred tax “loss carryforwards” figure (tax loss carryforwards) rather than a separately disclosed NOL cash balance. ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))
Comps: EV/NTM revenue and several EV/EBITDA/forward P/E fields are left null because those specific NTM/forward metrics were not consistently retrievable within the data limits for this run.

catalysts: Execution and closing of the Cogentrix acquisition (mid-to-late 2026 expected close). ([investor.vistracorp.com](https://investor.vistracorp.com/2026-02-26-Vistra-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))

Delivering against 2026 guidance ranges for Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted FCFbG as hedges roll off and new contract coverage is realized. ([investor.vistracorp.com](https://investor.vistracorp.com/2026-02-26-Vistra-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))

Continued shareholder returns via the buyback program (remaining authorization referenced in the 2025 results release). ([investor.vistracorp.com](https://investor.vistracorp.com/2026-02-26-Vistra-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))
company_overview: Vistra (NYSE: VST) operates as a power generator and retail electricity provider with multiple generation and contracted revenue components. ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

The company’s operating results and valuation model inputs are grounded in GAAP line items (operating revenues, operating income, depreciation & amortization, and cash-flow capex) from its most recent Form 10-K. ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

Vistra’s latest disclosed liquidity and 2026 operating guidance are framed around “ongoing operations” metrics (Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted FCF before growth). ([investor.vistracorp.com](https://investor.vistracorp.com/2026-02-26-Vistra-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))
current_context: In the Feb 26, 2026 full-year 2025 release, Vistra guided 2026 Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA to $6.8B-$7.6B and Ongoing Operations Adjusted FCFbG to $3.925B-$4.725B. ([investor.vistracorp.com](https://investor.vistracorp.com/2026-02-26-Vistra-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))

Management stated Vistra has hedged ~100% of expected 2026 generation volumes (as of Feb 18, 2026), supporting cash-flow visibility under current market curves. ([investor.vistracorp.com](https://investor.vistracorp.com/2026-02-26-Vistra-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))

The company also highlighted a plan to acquire Cogentrix (~5,500 MW), with expectations to close mid-to-late 2026. ([investor.vistracorp.com](https://investor.vistracorp.com/2026-02-26-Vistra-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))
investment_highlights: Base case revenue growth is modest (2-3%) and works from the last historical GAAP revenue base (FY2025 operating revenues). ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

EBIT margin is modeled to normalize upward from the FY2025 operating-income compression toward a mid-cycle level (~13.5-14.3%) to reflect a more normalized operating environment. ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

The DCF reinvestment profile transitions from elevated FY2025 capex intensity toward a steadier range (modeled ~12-13% of sales). ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

Working capital is modeled as persistently negative as a function of Vistra’s balance sheet structure (margin/affiliate-related items embedded in current balances). ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))
key_risks: Earnings and cash-flow volatility driven by commodity price spreads, generation outages, and mark-to-market accounting impacts. ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

Higher-than-modeled capital intensity or execution risk from announced growth investments and acquisitions. ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

Working capital dynamics (including current-balance items like margin/derivative-linked balances) could deviate materially from the modeled negative NWC profile. ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

valuation_summary: The DCF input package uses GAAP operating income (EBIT proxy), depreciation & amortization, capex (cash-flow line), and a consistent net working capital construction for the historical anchor. ([filecache.investorroom.com](https://filecache.investorroom.com/mr5ir_vistracorp_ir/339/VST_10-K_2026-02-27.pdf))

Terminal value is set via an exit multiple framework (terminal exit EV/EBITDA multiple = 9.0) consistent with large-cap power sector valuation ranges. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nrg/statistics/?utm_source=openai))
Comps are included for context; however, EV/NTM revenue could not be fully populated from retrieved snippets, so several comps fields are left null with explicit notes.
